brief.body: You'll read some messages customers sent to support, and say what kind of request each one is, using the descriptions given. About 8 minutes.

consent.heading: Before you begin
consent.text:
We record your answers, how long each task takes and anything you type. You are identified only by a code, never your name.

Your answers stay on this device until the research team exports them, are used only for this study, and are deleted 90 days after it ends. You can stop at any time.

items.label: I've read how my answers will be used

hypotheses.statement: Support staff classify requests into the four proposed types the same way, without needing "Other".

tasks.title: Classify support requests
tasks.scenario: Choose the request type each message belongs to.
tasks.confidence: How confident are you in your choices overall?

categories.label: Account access
categories.definition: Can't sign in, locked out, password or two-step problems.

categories.label: Billing
categories.definition: Charges, refunds, invoices and payment methods.

categories.label: Order problem
categories.definition: Late, missing, damaged or wrong items.

categories.label: Product question
categories.definition: How something works, sizes, compatibility, care.

items.text: I've been charged twice for the same order
The code you texted me never arrives
Parcel says delivered but nothing here
Is the blue one machine washable?
Can I get a VAT invoice for my company?
The box was crushed and the lamp is broken

closing.prompt: Which two types were hardest to tell apart?
